verdict.rationale: Jira documents enterprise search that finds work across Jira, Confluence (docs) and connected apps from a single search bar. Community users also value JQL and REST queries as Jira's query layer. However, comment search is not documented, and nothing evidences that results are fast or accurate; one user notes under-resourced on-prem Lucene indexes perform badly. missing for 10: explicit coverage of comments in search, evidence of search speed and relevance/accuracy, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-product search.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results

citations.quote: Use enterprise search to find anything across Jira, Confluence, and any connected app from a single search bar.
That's what I appreciate most about Jira.
One of the things I like most about Jira is the ability to execute useful queries via REST on the data stored in there.
